ExcerptText: Dollar-bracket approval requirements: 0 to 9,999 line manager no board escalation; 10,000 to 49,999 department head no board escalation; 50,000 and above finance VP required if over 500,000.
Notes: Direct policy text on approval thresholds

ExcerptText: The finance organization has sole authority to approve any purchase whose total contract value meets or exceeds the 50,000 threshold.
Notes: Direct policy text on finance authority

ExcerptText: Any purchase whose contract contains non-standard indemnity liability or IP-assignment clauses MUST receive legal review before execution. This policy does NOT specify whether legal review is a blocking gate or a concurrent advisory function.
Notes: Direct policy quote — notable because the policy itself acknowledges the ambiguity

ExcerptText: This policy does NOT address purchases affecting operational capacity... Practice in affected business units has been inconsistent.
Notes: Direct policy gap acknowledgment for ops role

ExcerptText: For anything at 50,000 or above finance is the approver. If legal has concerns they can comment but finance's call is final — the policy says it plainly. Legal is advisory on contract terms not a gate.
Notes: Finance PM's verbatim attestation of legal-as-advisory

ExcerptText: Usually three business days once the request hits the finance inbox. Legal review if needed adds maybe two days. Not blocking.

Our review is a blocking gate not advisory. If we flag a clause as unacceptable the deal doesn't move forward until it's renegotiated or escalated to general counsel. A finance-approved deal that we flagged got rolled back by GC. Since then finance approvals on non-standard-clause contracts wait on our sign-off.
Notes: Legal PM's verbatim attestation of legal-as-blocking-gate; directly contradicts E-005

ExcerptText: Five business days on a first pass. Another three if the vendor pushes back. So the legal adds two days claim you might have heard is wrong for anything substantive.
Notes: Legal PM's timing claim; directly contradicts E-006
